description: This source file defines an internal sealed class 'CachingSiloAddressCodec' responsible for serializing and caching 'SiloAddress' objects. It optimizes repeated serialization through caching mechanisms, periodically purges stale entries, and internally manages both shared and private caches for efficiency within the Orleans distributed application framework.

classes.name: CachingSiloAddressCodec
classes.description: A serializer for SiloAddress which caches values and avoids re-encoding and unnecessary allocations.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a SiloAddress object from the provided reader, utilizing cache and shared cache for efficiency.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes a SiloAddress object to the provided writer, updating caches and performing garbage collection as needed.

methods.name: PurgeStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes cache entries that have not been accessed within a specified timeframe to prevent unbounded memory growth.

methods.name: ReadSiloAddressInner
methods.description: Internal helper to deserialize a SiloAddress from binary data.

methods.name: WriteSiloAddressInner
methods.description: Internal helper to serialize a SiloAddress into binary format.
